skills.account-briefing-boards.1: Account research turned into four boards a prospect can read in a minute. Day one: the four boards on
skills.account-people-classifier.1: Everyone at a target company, through narrow typed questions: what they do, and whether they sell. Day one: 57 people, 107 calls, $0.003, counts only.
skills.account-scrape-apify.1: Public data on a target company without logging into anyone's LinkedIn: employees, profiles, posts and transcripts. Day one: 279 results for $1.24.
skills.agent-view-generator.1: A button-free Markdown copy of the site, plus /llms.txt, built from the site's own content files so it can't drift from what a person sees.
skills.brand-clone-tokens.1: A company's live website read at four screen widths, its real colours, fonts, spacing and motion turned into tokens. Day one: the look of this site.
skills.brand-voice-posts-graded-blind.1: A company's voice as rules, posts written to them, and a separate judge that wrote none of them. Day one: 5 posts met all 21 rules; a plain prompt met 12.
skills.build-in-public-feed.1: Every 30 minutes, what was recorded and what changed became a short post and a build request to the website. Day one: 10 posts went live without me asking.
skills.capture-rig.1: Four commands record the screen, a webcam and a mic, transcribe on the GPU and file it all by session. Day one: about 5 h 30 min recorded.
skills.group.1: Find the accounts and the people
skills.hero.1: Each one is a skill or a script now. Give it the next account and it runs.
skills.icp-grid-from-client-site.1: Four read-only research agents read a company's whole website and turn it into its customer profiles. Day one: 4 ICPs from Addvery's 12 case studies.
skills.lead-router.1: Each lead's ICP, language and tactic, with the reason for every decision, and every no-fit logged. Day one: 12 leads, 4 by rules alone.
skills.linkedin-wall-builder.1: A person's public LinkedIn posts as a scrollable wall, word for word, with their images. Day one: my wall.
skills.onepassword-batch.1: Every key a task needs with one 1Password approval. No value is ever printed, and no key moves while the screen records.
skills.operator-attention-controls.1: Every question from every session waits at one desk, one at a time, with a stated default after 15 minutes, and a way back when sessions die.
skills.outbound-workflow-factory.1: One copy file per ICP in, every LinkedIn sequence in GetSales out, message 1 set to the one variable. Day one: 36 workflows in 7 minutes.
skills.publish-leak-scan.1: Every draft, page and request scanned for API keys, deny-listed terms, emails and phone numbers before anything is committed or published.
skills.research-desk.1: About four questions per research list, then three wildcard researchers sent after the biggest open question. Day one: 27 reports, indexed.
skills.spec-driven-agent-team.1: One charter says why and what; each deliverable gets a spec, its own session, a definition of done and a decision log. Day one: about 15 sessions, 739 commits.
skills.stakeholder-landing-pages.1: A page per decision-maker, in their company's look, with what matters to their role. Day one: these six.
skills.taste-grading-booth.1: Short moments played blind, graded with one key, against a hold-out locked before grading starts. Day one: 127 moments.
skills.transcript-to-article.1: Someone's spoken words turned into a near-final article in their own voice. Day one: three entries from my recordings.
